== frame refused cursor=5,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ set TMPDIR scratch
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ TMPDIR=missing cp source refused-copy
|<SHELL>: cp: source: No such file or directory (os error 2)
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~

== frame refused_status cursor=8,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ set TMPDIR scratch
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ TMPDIR=missing cp source refused-copy
|<SHELL>: cp: source: No such file or directory (os error 2)
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 set
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~

== frame accepted_status cursor=13,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ set TMPDIR scratch
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ TMPDIR=missing cp source refused-copy
|<SHELL>: cp: source: No such file or directory (os error 2)
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cp source accepted-copy
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 set
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 TMPDIR=missing
@5 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@5 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@8 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cp
@10 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@10 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@13 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== effect refused_copy
|absent
== effect accepted_copy
|selected scratch
== effect selected_tmpdir
|scratch
